note.es: Salario bruto anual por persona, sumando todos sus pagadores (modelo 190), sin ajustar por tiempo trabajado: incluye jornadas parciales y años incompletos. Sin País Vasco ni Navarra.
note.en: Gross annual wage per person, adding up all payers (form 190), not adjusted for time worked: includes part-time work and part years. Excludes the Basque Country and Navarre.
note.ca: Salari brut anual per persona, sumant tots els pagadors (model 190), sense ajustar pel temps treballat: inclou jornades parcials i anys incomplets. Sense País Basc ni Navarra.

calculation.method: mean of the distribution "wage-earners-women" (see Distributions on the methodology page). AEAT, Mercado de trabajo y pensiones en las fuentes tributarias: wage earners, wages and average wage by wage bracket, filtered by sex in the table's own menu (multiples of the annual SMI). Mean = total wages / wage earners.
